how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed application form (proforma enclosed with the advertisement, also on police.odisha.gov.in).
Fill in the form neatly typed, completing all columns correctly.
Sign declaration (A) on information and declaration (B) on good health for the physical test.
Enclose two passport size self-attested photographs, self-attested age and qualification certificates, discharge certificate and two character certificates.
Send the application to the Inspector General of Police, Central Range, Kataka.
Application must reach the office by 16.11.2026 at 6.30 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date will be summarily rejected Application must be neatly typed as per the enclosed proforma Re-employed persons must wear the uniform and badge prescribed by D.G & I.G of Police, Odisha Applicant declares the authority is not responsible for any accident or injury during the physical test

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Odisha Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Odisha Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 126 vacancies: 14 Special Police Officer (SPO) - Khordha, 36 Special Police Officer (SPO) - Puri, 17 Special Police Officer (SPO) - Kataka, 9 Special Police Officer (SPO) - Kendrapada, 15 Special Police Officer (SPO) - Nayagada, 23 Special Police Officer (SPO) - Jajpur and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Odisha Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma enclosed with the advertisement (pages 3-4 English, pages 7-8 Odia); also on Odisha Police website police.odisha.gov.in) and send it to Office of the Inspector General of Police, Central Range, Kataka, by by post / reach to office, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 65 years (as on date of publication of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As fixed per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No 25745/F, dtd. 01.10.2026 for Special Police Officer (SPO) - Khordha, As fixed per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No 25745/F, dtd. 01.10.2026 for Special Police Officer (SPO) - Puri, As fixed per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No 25745/F, dtd. 01.10.2026 for Special Police Officer (SPO) - Kataka, As fixed per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No 25745/F, dtd. 01.10.2026 for Special Police Officer (SPO) - Kendrapada, As fixed per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No 25745/F, dtd. 01.10.2026 for Special Police Officer (SPO) - Nayagada.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Asst. Sub-Inspector / Sub-Inspector / Inspector of Police of Odisha Police who worked with State Police in one of these ranks; no educational qualification specified. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a permanent resident of Odisha. Must be able to speak, read and write Odia. Must have an unblemished service record and very good/good CCR/PAR for continuous sixty months before superannuation. Must have no criminal case pending and not have more than one spouse living.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons convicted in any criminal case or awarded major punishment in departmental proceedings during service career. Persons with physical deformities are not eligible for appointment. Candidates not found medically fit are not allowed in further tests. Candidates failing to cover 5 km on foot within one hour are disqualified.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Verification of original documents. Medical test. Physical test (5 km on foot within one hour). Interview before Selection Board.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual basis for a period of one year. Agreement for re-employment on contract basis for not more than one year must be executed. Liable to be discharged from the contract if information furnished is found incorrect.
